interventions.title: Raised Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Given the residential nature and narrow street, a raised crossing would further calm traffic and prioritize pedestrian movement.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Implement strict enforcement of sidewalk parking bans and install bollards or high curbs to physically prevent vehicles from mounting the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure that private property elements like stairs and railings do not impede the minimum required clear width for a pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Waste Management Solutions
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk storage areas or consolidated collection points to keep the narrow walkways clear of bins.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Adding street trees where space permits would provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Supplementing existing tall street lights with lower, pedestrian-scale lamps to improve visibility and security on the narrow sidewalks.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer from the roadway.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated areas for waste bins to ensure the sidewalk remains clear and accessible for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing
interventions.description: Implement better trash management to keep the narrow walkways clear of obstructions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Waste Management and Clearing
interventions.description: Implement more frequent trash collection and sidewalk clearing programs to ensure walkways remain unobstructed.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk and roadway surfaces to prevent trips and falls.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lights to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk on the right side to provide a consistent, ADA-compliant clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the ends of the block to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Resurface the walkway and ensure a minimum clear width of 5 feet to improve accessibility and meet ADA standards.

interventions.title: Trash Management Solutions
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk storage for waste bins to ensure the clear walking path is maintained.

interventions.title: Curb Extension / Tree Bump-out
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway/parking lane around the tree to maintain a continuous, ADA-compliant clear walking width without removing the mature tree.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Leveling and Repair
interventions.description: Repair the cracked sections of the sidewalk to provide a smooth, hazard-free surface for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a new paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface or replace cracked concrete slabs to provide a smooth, level walking surface.

interventions.title: Clear Path of Travel
interventions.description: Remove or relocate the bollards to the edge of the curb to ensure a continuous, unobstructed walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees/Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk sections to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Trash Management Program
interventions.description: Implement designated areas or enclosures for trash receptacles to keep the pedestrian clear zone unobstructed.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the cracked and uneven concrete with a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Install a standard curb and a single, clearly defined driveway entrance to minimize the conflict zone between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Streetscape Improvements
interventions.description: Add street trees or a landscaped buffer to separate the walkway from the vacant lot and improve the visual environment.
